name: British Airways
species: None (no pets in the cabin on any route)
max_carrier_dimensions: Not applicable: BA carries no pets in the cabin
checked_or_cargo: Pets travel in the hold, arranged by partners: PetAir UK (from the UK) or IAG Cargo (to the UK).
service_animal_note: Assistance dogs fly free in the cabin on most BA flights; emotional support dogs are not accepted in the cabin and must travel as pets.
notes: Entering the UK requires the DEFRA Pet Travel Scheme.
